ops.title: Runbook: gated bring-up of container-native hermes (Architecture B)
ops.body:
Bring-up of the container-native hermes agent (plan z-4-virtual-generic-lampson). Every step is USER-run in Terminal.app (sudo, gui-domain launchctl, keychain are unavailable to the agent's background session). Design refs: supervisor+pf review outcomes (note f65d5cd), pf design (9623c9a), #1 TOCTOU reachability (a5f920d).

## Preconditions (verified 2026-07-18 on the host)
- `hermes-agent:latest` image loaded (digest 1d5ab4ca27c0); apiserver already `running`.
- socktainer at /opt/homebrew/opt/socktainer/bin/socktainer; `container` CLI at /opt/homebrew/bin/container.
- config.toml subnet override present (192.168.72.1/24).
- bootstrap bundle at ~/.config/yclaw/vm-secrets/ has all 4 (key.txt, secrets.sops.yaml, node.env, agent-vault-token); ~/.yclaw/state/hosts/hermes/ has key.txt + secrets.sops.yaml.
- go 1.26.1 on PATH (mise). `hermes` container name free.
- Leftover prototype scratch: containers e3-probe / e3-probe-int (192.168.73/74), images alpine/m1/m1b/m1blocal. Clear before the memory soak: `container rm -f e3-probe e3-probe-int`.

## Steps (Terminal.app)

1. Setup (stages node.env+token, `go build` the proxy, creates gid-1000 group + 2750 socket dir, installs the tick + pf daemon plist; sudo prompts internally):
   ```
   cd ~/Code/yclaw && bash scripts/setup.sh host-container
   ```

2. Load the egress pf daemon FIRST (backoff-waits for the 192.168.72.1 bridge; ready to enforce the moment container-hermes creates it):
   ```
   sudo launchctl bootstrap system /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.yclaw.container-pf-refresh.plist
   ```

3. Load the supervisor (apiserver → socktainer → proxy → the hermes container):
   ```
   launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.yclaw.container-hermes.plist
   ```

4. Watch the chain + the canary (the #2 guest-socket-gid verification is built in):
   ```
   tail -f ~/Library/Logs/yclaw/container-hermes.log ~/Library/Logs/yclaw/container-hermes.error.log
   ```
   - `chain up — ... container 'hermes' running` = healthy.
   - `WARN proxy canary did not complete (rc=2 ...)` = sup #2 IS real (guest socket root:root, dropped agent cannot connect) → needs the entrypoint `chgrp 1000 + chmod 0660` on the guest socket + an image REBUILD.
   - `FATAL proxy canary got a non-403 answer` = wrong/non-filtering socket (should not happen; container is force-removed).
   - No canary WARN/FATAL (crc==0) = #2 not a problem, chain fully verified.

5. Verify egress pf:
   ```
   tail /var/log/container-pf-refresh.log     # "egress limited to DNS+WG+443 (tier-2 moderate)"
   sudo pfctl -a com.apple/000.yclaw.container -sr
   ```

6. Explicit #2 guest-socket check (if step 4 WARNed rc=2):
   ```
   container exec --user 1000:1000 hermes stat -c '%u %g' /run/hermes-docker-proxy/docker.sock
   ```
   `0 0` (root:root) confirms sup #2 → entrypoint fix + rebuild.

7. tailnet join + reach metal (Phase 3c):
   ```
   container exec hermes tailscale status
   container exec hermes sh -c 'curl -sS --max-time 5 http://metal:8000/v1/models | head'
   ```

## Then Phase 3 (gates the cutover)
- 3a memory soak: sample the agent-VM + micro-VM backing RSS under real load; MUST stay ≤ the tart 4 GiB baseline (abort signal if it ratchets past).
- 3b reboot survival (USER-gated, briefly takes the fleet down): host reboot → the supervisor + pf daemon bring container-hermes fully back unattended.
- 3d e2e: a real BlueBubbles message → sandboxed code-exec → reply; `yclaw doctor hermes` (repointed) green.

## Notes
- Load order (pf daemon before supervisor) minimizes the unprotected-egress window; the bridge-timing question (does 192.168.72.1 exist at `container system start` or only at first `container run`?) is answered empirically here.
- A small remediation refinement to the tick (MARKER-on-crc0 semantics + a cross-tick counter for transient bad states) may land from an in-flight review; re-run step 1 to reinstall if so.
- #1 bind-source TOCTOU is a deferred post-cutover hardening (backstop gap, not a cutover blocker — task #23).
ops.when: Bringing up the container-native hermes stack on the host (first cutover, or after a reboot / setup change). USER-run in Terminal.app — the agent's background session cannot sudo / gui-launchctl.
